title: Captive guided cross for Alps Alpine SKRHADE010

coordinate_system.origin: SKRHADE010 stem axis on the UI PCB
coordinate_system.xy: X right and Y down when reading the front silkscreen
coordinate_system.z: outward from the UI PCB; PCB component-side copper datum is Z=0

split_stem_socket.retention_principle: four compliant jaws retain the cap on the round 3.0-mm stem; the square guide, not the stem, prevents rotation

front_panel_interface.anti_rotation_principle: the 5.6-mm square guide moves inside the 7.5-mm square aperture while the visible cross remains axis-aligned to the product legends

paper_checks.tolerance_model: guide and aperture each +/-0.15 mm, axis registration +/-0.10 mm, cap/panel Z stack +/-0.10 mm each

prototype_acceptance: all four directions and centre push actuate independently with no enclosure contact
a direction may be held while the firmware still reads an unambiguous single direction; adjacent-direction ambiguity is rejected
centre push does not create a directional event and a directional press does not create centre push
cap cannot rotate enough to swap user-visible direction semantics
cap survives removal and refit without cracking the switch stem; pull-off force and operating feel are recorded
aperture coupon spans nominal and tolerance-limit guide sizes before the complete front enclosure is released
release_boundary: The dimensioned paper geometry closes H1 source design. Received switch, PA12 coupon, fit, feel, retention and endurance remain an H5 gate before fabrication release.
